messages:
Jon (Collections): Valkyrie Therapeutics (acct VT-009) has invoice 2026-06-01 past due for $86,210. They claim a vendor pass-through billing error and want full credit + move to an escrow arrangement while they reconcile. Thoughts?
Maya (Finance): Full credit on 86k is risky. Do we have evidence? Any card on file?
Priya (Acct Exec): No card on file; they pay by AR transfer. They emailed a vendor invoice showing the pass-through and asked us to hold funds in escrow with their third-party until vendors reconcile.
Asha (Customer Success): I pulled logs — looks like one large batch from their vendor IPs, but not obviously duplicated on our side. Need to compare job ids vs vendor report. CS can validate, but it will take ~24-48h.
Dmitri (Legal): Escrow introduces legal overhead. We need written escrow terms, beneficiary details, and approval from Legal + Finance. We should not move money to a third party without CFO sign-off.
Jon (Collections): Draft a response offering a conditional path: partial credit pending verification or escrow only if certain conditions met (signed escrow agreement, wire to an approved escrow agent, signed payment plan). Can someone vet quick?
Maya (Finance): Prefer: 30% provisional credit only after CS verification AND receipt of 50% payment into Redwood holding account within 5 business days, remainder over 45 days. If they insist on escrow, require escrow funds upfront (not ours to move) and a signed, standard escrow agreement we approve.
Priya (Acct Exec): Customer wrote: "We request Redwood place disputed amount into our escrow agent (AcmeEscrow) while vendors reconcile. Will provide PO and escrow contact." They expect us to approve quickly.
Dmitri (Legal): We can accept escrow if: 1) escrow agent is vetted, 2) funds come from Valkyrie (not Redwood), 3) escrow agreement names Redwood as a stakeholder with clear release conditions, 4) our indemnity and fee clauses are included. Also require CFO email confirmation.
Asha (Customer Success): I'll ask the customer for the vendor reconciliation file and their escrow agreement. CS will flag any job-id mismatches.
Jon (Collections): Proposed external message (please edit):
Jon (Collections): ```Hi Valkyrie team 
Thanks for the details and the vendor invoice. Weve initiated an internal review and CS will verify the job ids you provided. We can offer two paths to resolve the outstanding invoice 2026-06-01 ($86,210):
1) Provisional credit path: After CS verification, we will issue a one-time provisional credit up to 30% of the invoice amount, contingent on receipt of 50% of the outstanding balance into our holding account within 5 business days and a signed payment agreement for the remainder (to be paid over 45 days).
2) Escrow path: We can accept funds held by a mutually agreed escrow agent provided the escrow agreement names Redwood and specifies explicit release conditions. Funds must originate from Valkyrie and escrow terms require our Legal approval prior to any release.
Please confirm which path you prefer and provide the escrow agreement (if applicable) and the vendor reconciliation file. Note: any credit/grant is contingent on CS verification and receipt of payment trace. Missed payments may result in late fees (1.5% monthly) and temporary suspension of Dedicated capacity and API keys.
-- Jon, Redwood Billing```
Maya (Finance): Add: "We will waive a single late fee if the provisional path is chosen and the 50% payment arrives on time and verification shows vendor error." Also cc billing@redwood.
Dmitri (Legal): Replace "temporary suspension" -> "temporary suspension of Dedicated capacity and API keys". Also: add clause that escrow acceptance does not waive our right to pursue outstanding amounts if escrow terms are not met.
Priya (Acct Exec): If they pick escrow, require an ACH/wire confirmation into escrow and CFO email. No funds = no hold.
collections-bot: Logged: account VT-009 | balance $86,210 | dispute-escrow-request | action-required: CS-verification + legal escrow review | follow-up 1804009680.
Asha (Customer Success): I'll request vendor reconciliation and the escrow docs now. Will post CSV and verification note when ready.
Jon (Collections): Sending with edits now and CC billing/legal. If no response by follow-up, escalate to VP Revenue. :email:
